correctness.rationale: Indicator expansion gives the diagonal term A_r q^n and the off-diagonal term A_r q^n-C(n,r)m^{-r}s^{n-r}, yielding the formula. With k=n-r, the sign is k>kappa. Equality would force (m-1)^(n+k-1)=m^(n-1)(m-2)^k, impossible by coprimality, so the switch is strict and unique.
correctness.risk: Uniform box probabilities are essential to the scalar threshold.

final_claim: In the uniform occupancy model, \(\operatorname{Cov}(K,K_r)=\binom nr\frac{m-1}{m^{r-1}}(q^{2n-r-1}-s^{n-r})\), and for \(m\ge3\) the signs across \(r\) have exactly one strict switch at \(r_*=n-\lfloor\kappa_{m,n}\rfloor\); for \(m=2\) they are positive for \(r<n\) and negative for \(r=n\).
